name: Kosuke Arai
source:
Kosuke Arai found himself in hell after a random school bus flattened him.

Before this tragedy, he was just an ordinary guy living in Japan. Kosuke loved drawing hentai, yaoi... Anything lewd, really.

It was his dirty mind that made Lucifer choose him to be the next Lust.

Now, Lucifer has given him a seemingly impossible task: seduce the other six Deadly Sins within two months, or forfeit the power and privilege of being Lust!

Kosuke will have to use every bit of charm to accomplish this... Or will he end up a failure... Another one of Lucifer's playthings?
